question: Advance received for GOODS (after Notification 66/2017) is:

options.text: Taxable on receipt - every advance received for goods attracts GST at the time of its receipt, whatever the date of the invoice
Taxable at the concessional rate of 5% at the time of receipt of the advance by the supplier, the balance being taxed on issue of the invoice
Fully exempt from GST - an advance for any supply of goods is never part of the value of supply
NOT taxable on receipt - time of supply of goods is fixed by the INVOICE; advances for goods no longer trigger GST for regular taxpayers

explanation: For registered persons, Notification 66/2017-Central Tax provides that GST on advances for goods is generally not payable on receipt; the time of supply is ordinarily linked to the invoice.
